title: Extremely useful
description: The app handles its core functions extremely well; and with each passing update, it’s become a personal favorite for time tracking. It’s a must have for those who need to keep track of many important events.
author: Maia

title: Craig Weiss
description: if you’re serious about your time, you need to confront the hard truth every day: your life is finite
author: @craigzLiszt

title: Best use of iPhone widgets
description: Literally the BEST app for tracking anything on your calender. It’s not only beautiful but it’s also so easy to use and the amount of fun features it packs deserves so much more recognition. Genuinely a solid app and it’s not often I'll adore something this much! Amazing work here!
author: Jake

title: The BEST iPhone Widgets You've NEVER Heard Of
description: Left is simple, but the widget library makes it feel much bigger than a normal habit tracker.
author: @WillBowers

title: Helps you be grateful of the time you have!
description: To be aware of the time that is left it such a gift, and this app does that so, so well! Days left in a year, weeks left in a life, time left until you've spent 90% of the time with your kids. This apps let you visualize, be conscious, and be grateful for the limited time we have. Bonus for probably the fairest pricing model out there!
author: Jog Manson

title: Jason Calacanis
description: This app just broke my brain, 35%, f*ck!
author: @Jason

title: Good for streaks without guilt
description: The streak widgets are motivating without feeling like a spreadsheet. Nice balance.
author: u/habitstack

title: Planner is underrated
description: Having calendar, reminders, weather, and my habits in one timeline is more useful than I expected.
author: Nina

title: Great for minimal home screens
description: The widgets look good enough to keep on the first page, which is half the battle.
author: Homescreen Weekly

title: Easlo
description: Turned 23 today. Visualizing our life in dots reminds me that our time here is short. Stop waiting. Start chasing those dreams.
author: @heyeaslo

title: Beautiful and practical!
description: This app is a testament to how great apps can be! Simple, less size, no tracking / subscription, and so on..  Widgets for this app are also great! I really wish this app is recommended in App Store or more easily findable on App Store! Came across this app on X (X (Twitter)).
author: Walker P.

title: Finally replaced three apps
description: Countdowns, habit tracking, and year progress in the same place is exactly what I needed.
author: u/iosminimal

title: The life in years widget hits
description: A little existential, but this app is great. It’s gorgeous, bloat-free, and not out to drain my soul. And it beautifully frames my existential crisis...
author: Aleick

title: Very polished
description: Great app from a great developer. Recommend to buy the Premioum version, get access to new features (always updated), and support a great initiative.
author: Markus

title: A smarter countdown app
description: Most countdown apps stop at dates. Left connects those dates to habits and planning.
author: Sarah Gray

title: The templates are useful
description: I expected filler templates, but there are genuinely good ideas for habits and milestones.
author: Roy

title: One of the only apps I’ve happily paid for
description: Clean designs, lots of options, and the app does not get in the way.
author: Chris M.

title: Simple idea, excellent execution
description: It makes time feel tangible. I use it every day without needing reminders.
author: Elena V.
